citations.quote: ECOG 1, asymptomatic aside from mild dry cough.
He has returned to baseline activity (ECOG performance status 0)

candidates.description: A scale used to assess a patient's functional ability and level of independence in daily activities.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify the numerical value associated with 'ECOG' or 'ECOG performance status'.
candidates.measurement_definition: A categorical scale from 0 (fully active) to 4 (completely disabled).
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The specific criteria used for grading ECOG in each clinical note are assumed to follow the standard ECOG scale, but are not explicitly defined within the text.

citations.quote: Stage IIA (T2aN1M0) left lower lobe adenocarcinoma, EGFR‑negative
diagnosed with stage IV (T2aN3M1) right‑upper‑lobe adenocarcinoma of the lung harboring an activating EGFR exon 19 deletion.

candidates.description: The presence or absence of activating mutations in the Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) gene in the tumor tissue.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Search for 'EGFR' in the pathology or molecular profile sections; identify if the patient is labeled 'EGFR-negative' or if a specific mutation/deletion is mentioned.
candidates.measurement_definition: Categorized as 'EGFR-negative' (Wild-type) or 'Mutant' if an activating mutation is identified (e.g., 'EGFR exon 19 deletion').
candidates.name: EGFR Mutation Status
candidates.uncertainty: It is uncertain if all patients underwent the same molecular testing method (e.g., NGS vs. PCR) to determine mutation status.

limitations: Sample size is very small, consisting of only a few patients.
Molecular profiling is not documented for all patients in the provided excerpts.
Baseline comorbidities are mentioned but not consistently structured across all patient records.
summary: The evidence identifies several measurable baseline clinical variables used to characterize patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), including functional status (ECOG) and molecular markers (EGFR status).
